reserveReview.rationale: M0's current first-party Protocol API exposes the total collateral snapshot but no longer exposes the former cash-versus-token composition feed. The live adapter therefore publishes the exact protocol-constrained aggregate slice; M0's token documentation identifies approved collateral backing the M token and its MinterGateway supply controls. No tracked reserve asset is named by the current aggregate, so the slice is intentionally non-linked and M0's internal cash/Treasury allocation remains an undisclosed detail of the aggregate.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: M0 Protocol API total collateral snapshot and M0 M Token documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The aggregate slice covers the full M0 eligible-collateral total; the current API does not publish its internal cash/Treasury allocation or minter-level provider shares.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: M0 Foundation documentation (2024-11-20) names the approved collateral structures — Superstate Inc. (investment manager) / Superstate Asset Trust (Delaware collateral storage vehicle) / UMB Bank, N.A. (custodian), and CrossLend GmbH (SPV operator) / Asset Repository S.a.r.l (Luxembourg SPV) / DEKA Bank (custodian) — with asset segregation under the Delaware Statutory Trust Act and bankruptcy-remoteness stated as a required structural property. The 97.9% UMB share maps the 2026-07-15 first-party collateral capture (97.9% USTB, sole eligible on-chain collateral token) to the USTB structure's documented custodian, so one structure/custodian chain concentrates >90% of collateral. Current minter-level allocation across the two structures, the ~2.1% cash custody arrangements, and a general rehypothecation prohibition are not publicly documented.
